scripts.dev: pnpm --filter @editor/shared run build && pnpm --parallel --filter server --filter web run dev
scripts.build: pnpm --filter @editor/shared run build && pnpm --filter server run build && pnpm --filter web run build
scripts.test: pnpm --filter @editor/shared --filter server --filter web --filter graph2 --filter graph-editor run test
scripts.test:coverage: pnpm --filter @editor/shared --filter server --filter web --filter graph2 --filter graph-editor run test:coverage
scripts.typecheck: pnpm --filter @editor/shared run build && pnpm --filter @editor/shared --filter server --filter web --filter graph2 --filter graph-editor run typecheck
scripts.ci: pnpm run check:comments && pnpm run check:ci && pnpm run typecheck && pnpm run test:coverage && pnpm run build && pnpm run test:e2e
